title: Tensor with a locally finite free coefficient sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme and $\Lambda$ any commutative ring object in abelian sheaves on profinite sets with coherent topology. Put $R=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $F,G$ be internal $R$-modules, with $F$ finite free after inverse image along some pro-etale covering of $X$, and $G$ locally finitely presented in the sense of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Then $F[0]\otimes_R^{\mathrm L}G[0]$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom] has no cohomology in negative degrees, and every cohomology module is locally finitely presented. Ranks may vary among covering objects; rank zero, zero modules and empty schemes are included.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(3), local finite projective resolution and tensor calculation

proof.text: Choose a pro-etale cover trivializing F. The canonical coefficient pullback isomorphism transports its finite free charts to normalized inverse image, and local finite presentation of G pulls back along the same cover. Use the proved free/comap/isomorphism comparisons and finite-presentation pullback comparisons, with no restriction on the covering schemes.

For F isomorphic to R^r, apply the degree-zero single functor to this isomorphism, distribute tensor over the finite biproduct, identify single(R) with the derived tensor unit, and apply the left unitor to each copy. This gives single(F) tensor single(G) isomorphic to single(G^r). The empty biproduct is zero. Finite sums of G are locally finitely presented by induction using the split short exact biproduct sequence.

Exact monoidal normalized pullback identifies the restricted derived tensor with that calculation and commutes with homology. Local degree-zero homology is a finite sum of restricted G; other degrees are zero. To descend vanishing, forget the module structure and use conservativity of localization restriction along a pro-etale cover on the zero morphism to zero. To descend local finite presentation, bind each local presentation cover to the original cover, using the pullback-composition comparison.

theorem locallyFree_tensor_single
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hF : ∃ U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod _).obj F))
    (hG : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ X) G) :
    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ⊗
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G).IsGE 0 ∧
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj Λ X)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ⊗
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))
